Red Carpet & Stanchion Rentals – Create a Grand Entrance

From $125 CAD

Make every guest feel like a VIP with our elegant red carpet and velvet rope stanchion rentals.

Perfect for weddings, galas, corporate events, birthdays, grand openings, photo ops, and upscale parties, this combination instantly adds sophistication, organization, and a polished event experience.

Our premium red carpet runner creates a stunning focal point for entrances, aisles, and photo areas, while our sleek stainless-steel stanchions with plush velvet ropes help guide guests and define spaces with style.

Why Rent Our Red Carpet & Stanchions?

Elegant VIP Experience Create a luxurious, photo-worthy entrance that makes a lasting first impression.

Perfect for Any Event Ideal for weddings, red carpet events, dances, award nights, birthday parties, corporate functions, and more.

Durable & Event Ready Sturdy weighted bases stay secure indoors or outdoors, even in high-traffic areas.

Professional Crowd Flow Keep entrances organized while adding an upscale, polished touch to your event décor.

Whether you’re creating a glamorous aisle, a celebrity-style entrance, or a stylish photo moment, our red carpet and stanchion package brings elegance and functionality together seamlessly.
